_about: Owner/GM career: calendar, money, contracts, transfers, staff, youth, fans and the lender ladder. Read by src/sim/career/*. Money is in Valmeran dollars per season unless a key says otherwise.

calendar._about: A year is four pre-season weeks plus the 35 season weeks. Yearly money (wages, sponsors, TV, merchandise, operations) is paid in equal weekly slices; gate money is paid per home match; prizes and the luxury tax settle at season end.

tiers._about: Difficulty comes from the club's market, not branding. Fortune is the owner's own money (finite; injections are permanent). Debt is a Harbourline Bank loan over five seasons.

aiClubs._about: AI clubs keep books too. Starting cash scales with the club's finances rating.

tickets._about: Fair price = base + perMarket x market size. Attendance share = engine share x (fair / price)^elasticity, clamped. AI clubs charge the fair price.

merchandise._about: Per season: base + perMarket x market^exponent x fan mood.

sponsors._about: Shirt sponsor per season: base + perMarket x market^exponent, with a spread across offers. Offers arrive at the start of pre-season when no deal is running; an unchosen offer is signed automatically when the season starts.

namingRights._about: A one-off lump sum for renaming the stadium, sized from the market. Costs fan mood once.

operations._about: Running the club and the ground per season.

wageCap._about: Soft cap on player payroll (the average across the year). Every dollar over is taxed; repeat offenders pay the higher rate. The pot is shared equally by clubs under the cap.

lenders._about: Rates are yearly. Tallow & Finch also run the emergency overdraft.

ladder._about: Trouble with lenders. Level 0 = fine. 1 warning letter, 2 lender-appointed CFO, 3 spending lock, 4 forced sales, 5 receivership (game over). An overdraft or a broken loan condition triggers it; good weeks bring it back down.

transfers._about: Asking price = value x role factor x contract factor. Bids at or above asking are accepted, bids within counterShare get a counter at the midpoint, the rest are refused.
transfers._aboutEmergency: If the user's squad drops below emergencyFillTo players (or two goalkeepers), the league tops it up with free agents on one-year minimum deals.

loans._about: Loans run to the end of the season. Fee is a share of value; the borrower pays a share of the wage.

scouting._about: The uncertainty of an unknown player's rating shown as a range. Error = (100 - head scout rating) / divisor, rounded. Your own squad is always exact.

staff._about: Coaching quality for development = head coach x weight + assistant x weight (0-1). Staff renew automatically when their deal ends.

youth._about: Intake at the end of each season: domestic prospects aged 16-19. Academy levels 1-5.

fans._about: Fan mood moves with results and ticket prices and drifts back toward the club's baseline. pricePenaltyPerOverFair is taken per 10% the ticket price sits over the fair price, per home match.

aging._about: Retirement chance rises each year from startAge; everyone retires at forcedAge.

aiSquads._about: AI clubs renew useful players and top up thin squads from free agents.

squadQuality._about: Each offseason a club's squad quality (used for crowds, sponsors and AI planning) is recomputed from the average overall of its best eleven: baseQuality + perPoint x (average - baseOverall), clamped.

results._about: Finished seasons keep each match's score, team stats and goals/cards/injuries only, to keep saves small.
